descriptions.notStarted: Anyway, how's that baby Lioner doing? I better check on it at Maya's house.
descriptions.inProgress: Maya decided to disguise Lionel as a housecat by dressing it up with a necklace. Since buying one at a local department store may give it away, she wanted me to ask Teo of Lith Harbor for help.
descriptions.completed: Teo decided to help make Lionel's necklace.
